blurb: Arthur Murray Dance Center of Temple offers ballroom dance lessons in various partner styles such as Waltz, Rumba, Two-step, Swing, Salsa, and Tango. They provide individual lessons, group classes, and social dance events. New students can start with an Introductory Lesson and participate in drop-in classes and dance parties.
